verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing docs show strong support for scoped spend controls — dynamic spending limits, merchant category restrictions, transaction rules to auto-approve/decline, real-time relayed authorization for per-transaction decisioning, and per-card balances — which together let a developer approximate 'one purchase, one merchant, exact amount' controls (docs-3, docs-18, docs-22, docs-16). However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated single-use/one-time-use card type or automatic self-invalidation after one use, so the 'leaked number worthless after first use' guarantee isn't directly evidenced. missing for 10: explicit single-use card creation/expiry-after-use feature, documented exact-amount lock enforcement, independent confirmation of this behavior in practice.
